title: 第十七章 血色世界第十八章 古塔黑龙
lines: 第十七章：血色世界
暗黑血色的天地如同一副画卷，仿佛随时便可渗出鲜血来。叶重微闭着双眼，躺在血泊之中，一袭白衣已破碎脏乱不堪，杂着血泥的衣衫如同夹布条般挂在身上。
这是一片尸山血海，密密麻麻的尸体堆砌成山的世界。四周一片死寂，断裂的尸骨躺落在血泊之中，迎风而立。
“这是哪里？”，一道沙哑的声音打破了死寂，叶重起身，一暗灰色的兽骨骨刺插在他身旁的地上，其胸前有着一道醒目的伤痕，血已经凝固。叶重轻微一动，撕心裂肺的剧痛顿时席卷全身。
叶重这才想起来，在黎力抱着自己跳入阴魔渊，被自己狠踢时。黎力虽被自己踢开了，但自己也被黎力奋死将灰铁豺的骨刺，插入了自己的胸口。虽然在落地之前，忍痛将那骨刺拔了出来，但也使得自己疼痛的昏死了过去。
缓缓起身，叶重难得恢复了不少力气，随即双手拔出略有些沉重的灰铁豺骨刺，将其当做防身和拐杖之用。
叶重举目望去，这里完全是一片尸海，暗黑色的血流汇聚成泊。迎面扑来的血腥味，让以为自己已经看惯生死的叶重，也是感到一阵恶心和眩晕。
随后，叶重抬头一看，只见四周的悬崖峭壁，像刀削过一样，望不到尽头。整个世界布满了暗黑色的血气，使人仿佛身置炼狱一般，叶重暗暗咋舌低语道：“不愧魔渊之名，这阴魔渊当真是恐异无比。”。
甩了甩头，叶重缓慢驱逐身体的不适感。叶重却也是无暇，去审视这阴魔渊的恐异。现在叶重的首要之急，是要想办法出去，否则没有食物和水源的他，可支撑不了几天！
正在叶重寻找出路之时，天鹰峰上的天鹰堡，可是乱做了一团。
在天鹰堡一处大堂中，只见一身穿黑色铁甲的大汉，屈膝在地，躬身对着坐在上位的沈浩和沈彤恭敬道：“禀告堡主、大小姐！我们搜寻了方圆五十里的范围，都没有找到重少爷，恐怕·····”。
扫了一脸脸色愈加难看的沈彤，沈浩摆了摆手，“下去吧！继续加派人手，扩大搜索范围，务必要找到重少爷。”。
黑甲大汉点了点头，恭声道：“是！”，随即趋步退出大堂之外。
看着退出大堂外的黑甲大汉，沈浩转身对着身旁的沈彤安慰道：“彤儿，不必担心。重儿这孩子，从小少年老成，行事稳重，不会出什么事的！”。
坐在沈浩二人下手的沈玥，也是立即掩饰住脸庞之上的担忧，强露微笑的对沈彤安慰道：“姑姑你放心吧！叶重哥哥，那么好，一定吉人自有天相，不会有事的！”。
闻言，沈彤却是摇了摇头，语气冰冷的道：“通过桃花坳中残留的妖兽尸体，可以得知重儿先是遭受一阶妖兽灰铁豺的围攻，然后失踪的。而父亲您应该清楚，在桃花坳那地方，平日里连普通野兽都很少出没，更何况是一阶妖兽灰铁豺！”。
撇了眼脸色微变的沈浩，沈彤接着说道：“只怕是有人故意针对重儿，而不是所谓的意外！”。
顿了顿，沈彤眼露杀机的沉声道：“无论是谁，想杀我沈彤的儿子，我就要他全族陪葬，不死不休！”。
正在此时，一只长着洁白如雪的羽毛的鸽子，瞬时飞向了大厅之内，落在了沈浩的手中。随即只见沈浩从白鸽的左脚踝处，拿出一张纸条看了起来。
看完纸条，沈浩脸色一变，随即递给沈彤，冷声道：“刚刚接到影卫探子来报，居住在城主府的药皇殿少殿主皇甫炎的跟班头领，昨夜与尹克西密谈了会，就立即出府走了，而且在桃花坳一带消失不见了！”
“并且少城主尹框，曾带领一群家族死士，埋伏在天鹰堡通往桃花坳的必经之路上。不过却并没有发生任何战斗，其在黄昏时分，就又带人离开了，很是异常！”。
随即面露杀机的冷声道：“看来，重儿无故失踪之事，与城主府和药皇殿脱不了干系！”。
只见一簇紫色的火焰，从沈彤手心闪过，那张纸片顿时化为了虚无，“尹克西，我本无意于助我天鹰堡，与你尹家争锋，只想安稳的生活。但你千不该万不该，去把注意打到我儿子的身上。你要作死，就怪不得我了！”。
随即只见沈彤迅速起身，向前凌空一踏飞出厅外，只传来一道不容置疑的冰冷话语：“父亲，派人召回正在领人寻找重儿下落的大哥和叔父。我现在亲自去寻找重儿的下落，在明日日出之时，没找到重儿我就会回来，助你和大哥、叔父他们突破武王。然后去问一问尹克西这个老混蛋，甚至杀上那药皇殿，为重儿讨回一个公道！”。
看着化作一个黑点的沈彤，沈浩沉重冰冷的脸庞却是闪过一丝喜意的道：“尹克西，人算不如天算，该是我沈家崛起的时候了！”。

Chapter 17: Bloody World
The dark and bloody world was like a picture scroll, as if blood could seep out at any time. Ye Chong closed his eyes slightly and lay in a pool of blood. His white clothes were torn and dirty, and the clothes mixed with blood and mud hung on his body like strips of cloth.
This is a world of mountains of corpses and seas of blood, with densely packed corpses piled up into mountains. There was deathly silence all around, and the broken bones lay in a pool of blood, standing against the wind.
"Where is this?" A hoarse voice broke the dead silence. Ye Zhong stood up, and a dark gray animal bone spur was inserted into the ground beside him. There was a striking scar on his chest, and the blood had solidified. Ye Zhong moved slightly, and a heartbreaking pain suddenly swept through his body.
Ye Zhong then remembered that when Li Li jumped into the Yin Demon Abyss with him in his arms, he was kicked hard by him. Although Li Li was kicked away by him, he was also killed by Li Li and inserted the bone spur of the gray iron jackal into his chest. Although he reluctantly pulled out the bone spur before landing, he still fainted from the pain.
Standing up slowly, Ye Zhong recovered a lot of strength, and then pulled out the slightly heavy gray iron spur with both hands, using it as self-defense and a crutch.
Ye Zhong raised his eyes and looked around. It was completely a sea of ​​corpses, with dark black blood flowing into a pool. The smell of blood that rushed towards him made Ye Zhong, who thought he was used to seeing life and death, feel nauseated and dizzy.
Then, Ye Zhong looked up and saw the surrounding cliffs, as if they had been cut with a knife, with no end in sight. The whole world was filled with dark blood, making people feel like they were in purgatory. Ye Zhong secretly whispered: "As expected of the name of the Demon Abyss, this Yin Demon Abyss is really terrifying."
Ye Zhong shook his head and slowly drove away the discomfort in his body. Ye Zhong, however, had no time to examine the horrors of the Yin Demon Abyss. Ye Chong's first priority now is to find a way out, otherwise he won't be able to survive for a few days without food and water!
While Ye Zhong was looking for a way out, the Sky Eagle Fort on the Sky Eagle Peak was in chaos.
In a lobby of Tianying Fort, a big man in black armor was seen. He knelt on the ground and bowed to Shen Hao and Shen Tong who were sitting in the upper seats. He said respectfully: "Fortress Lord, Miss! We have searched a radius of fifty miles, but we have not found Master Zhong. I'm afraid..."
After glancing at Shen Tong, whose expression became increasingly ugly, Shen Hao waved his hand, "Go on! Continue to send more manpower, expand the search area, and be sure to find Master Zhong.".
The big man in black armor nodded, said respectfully: "Yes!", and then walked out of the lobby.
Seeing the big man in black armor exiting the lobby, Shen Hao turned to comfort Shen Tong beside him: "Tong'er, don't worry. This kid, Chong'er, has grown up since he was young and behaves steadily. Nothing will happen to him!".
Shen Yue, who was sitting next to Shen Hao and Shen Hao, immediately concealed the worry on her face and comforted Shen Tong with a forced smile: "Auntie, don't worry! Brother Ye Zhong, you are so good. You must be a lucky person and everything will be fine!".
Hearing this, Shen Tong shook his head and said in a cold tone: "From the corpses of the monster beasts left in Taohua Ao, we can know that Zhong'er was first besieged by the first-order monster gray iron jackal and then disappeared. And father, you should know that in Taohua Ao, even ordinary beasts rarely appear on weekdays, let alone the first-order monster gray iron jackal!".
Glancing at Shen Hao, whose expression changed slightly, Shen Tong continued: "I'm afraid it's someone deliberately targeting Zhong'er, rather than a so-called accident!".
After a pause, Shen Tong said in a deep voice with murderous intent in his eyes: "No matter who wants to kill my son, Shen Tong, I will bury his whole family with him until death!".
At this moment, a pigeon with feathers as white as snow flew into the hall instantly and landed in Shen Hao's hands. Then Shen Hao took out a piece of paper from Bai Ge's left ankle and read it.
After reading the note, Shen Hao's expression changed, and he handed it to Shen Tong and said in a cold voice: "I just received a report from the Shadow Guard spies. The leader of the followers of Huang Fuyan, the Young Master of the Yaohuang Palace who lives in the City Lord's Mansion, had a talk with Yin Keximi last night, immediately left the mansion, and disappeared in the Taohua'ao area!"
"And Young City Lord Yin Ji once led a group of family warriors to ambush on the only road from Tianying Castle to Taohua Pass. However, no battle took place. At dusk, he led others away again, which was very abnormal!"
Then he said in a cold voice with murderous intent on his face: "It seems that Zhong'er's disappearance for no reason has something to do with the City Lord's Palace and Yaohuang Palace!".
I saw a cluster of purple flames flashing from Shen Tong's palm, and the piece of paper suddenly turned into nothingness, "Yin Kexi, I had no intention of helping my Tianying Castle to compete with your Yin family. I just wanted to live a stable life. But you should never pay attention to my son. If you want to die, you can't blame me!"
Immediately, Shen Tong stood up quickly, stepped forward and flew out of the hall. Only an unmistakable cold word came: "Father, send someone to recall the eldest brother and uncle who are leading people to find Zhong'er's whereabouts. I will go to find Zhong'er myself now." When the sun rises tomorrow, if I don’t find Zhong’er, I will come back to help you and your eldest brother and uncle break through King Wu. Then go ask Yin Kexi, the old bastard, and even go to the Yaohuang Palace to seek justice for Zhong’er!”
Looking at Shen Tong who had turned into a black dot, Shen Hao's heavy and cold face flashed with a hint of joy and said: "Yin Kexi, it is time for our Shen family to rise!".
